edge_kinds.STATE_DELAY: state from time t to t+1
edge_kinds.CASCADE_PLACE: same-time propagation from basal section j to apical section j+1
edge_kinds.NEIGHBOR_PLACE: spatial coupling between adjacent cochlear places
edge_kinds.QUOTIENT_MEMBERSHIP: fine detector belongs to an explicit quotient set
edge_kinds.POSITIVE_MEASURE: convert detector activity to nonnegative energy
edge_kinds.PROBABILITY_NORMALIZE: divide node energy by frame total
edge_kinds.DISCRETE_CAST: finite Q15 code to binary32 bit pattern
edge_kinds.FRAME_GLOBAL: operation depending on all values in a frame
edge_kinds.TEMPORAL_LOOKAHEAD: batch dependency on future CAR-FAC frame t+1 or t+2
edge_kinds.SAMPLE_FITTED_TRANSPORT: finite-sample affine specialization; no universal claim
